title: ReFRAG SpectralChunk
description: One windowed segment of raw numerical data produced by spectral_chunker and consumed by spectral_chunk_encode. Mirrors the SpectralChunk dataclass at adapters/od_refrag_adapter.py:42. The chunk_id is deterministic: sha256(f'{source_id}:{window_start}:{window_end}')[:16].

source_id.description: Identifier for the originating data source (e.g. 'spin-boson-0042.npy').

window_start.description: Inclusive start index of this window in the source data array.

window_end.description: Exclusive end index of this window in the source data array. Must satisfy window_end > window_start.

values.description: Raw numerical values within the window. Length must equal window_end - window_start.

sample_rate.description: Data sample rate in Hz. Default 1.0 if omitted.
